content: Expression of optionality of containers, parameters and ref- erences When there is no multiplicity specified the default is exactly ' 1 ' meaning the element is mandatory in the ECU Configuration Value description and has to occur exactly once. To express an optional element the lowerMultiplicity has to be set to ' 0 '.
